cinematic_dialogue:3:1523203001:.text: The truce agreement puts us at the Wildborn's mercy!
cinematic_dialogue:3:1523203001:.source_cn: 停战合约令呼临受制于兽人

cinematic_dialogue:3:1523203002:.source_cn: 呼临怎可向野兽卑躬屈膝！

say:6:1523204001:0.text: Aurelin, do you have any idea what you're doing?!
say:6:1523204001:0.source_cn: 奥勒留！你知道你在干什么吗！

say:7:1523204002:1.text: Regulus Herennus granted you rank and riches to assist his son, not to defy his decisions like this!
say:7:1523204002:1.source_cn: 赫伦尼殿下许给你高官厚禄，是为了让你辅佐阿邦德殿下，为...

say:8:1523204003:1.text: Bakis, have you lost all sense?
say:8:1523204003:1.source_cn: 比博，你的脑袋里是什么时候灌满了泥浆？

say:9:1523204004:1.text: The agreement is a disgrace and harms our interests! I'm just trying to set things right!
say:9:1523204004:1.source_cn: 领主殿下一意孤行，与兽人签下耻辱的合约，损害呼临的利益...

say:10:1523204005:1.text: Since the Regulus refuses to listen to me, I shall make him hear the people's voices. He has to see how damaging this agreement is.
say:10:1523204005:1.source_cn: 既然我一个人说他不听，那我就带上民众，让他听听整个呼临...

say:11:1523204006:1.text: Don't sound all righteous! Your actions are the real bane of Halia!
say:11:1523204006:1.source_cn: 冠冕堂皇！你的所作所为才是在危害呼临！

say:12:1523204007:1.text: You're sowing distrust among the Halians and stirring unrest! Have you forgotten how we helped Regulus Herennus build this city? I'm sure you know what's at stake!
say:12:1523204007:1.source_cn: 抗议游行只会让民众对领主心生疑虑，令呼临动荡！当初你我...

say:13:1523204008:1.text: It's precisely because I care for Halia that I demand the agreement be annulled!
say:13:1523204008:1.source_cn: ——正是因为我为呼临考虑，才会要求撕毁停战合约！

say:14:1523204009:1.text: Wheat is our lifeline! You know as well as I do that we cannot properly digest most of the things we forage.
say:14:1523204009:1.source_cn: 麦种是呼临的命脉，绝对不能交由野蛮的兽人管理！

say:15:1523204010:1.text: Who can guarantee the Wildborn will honor the agreement? With the wheat in their hands, we can only wait for whatever they decide to give us.
say:15:1523204010:1.source_cn: 谁能保证那群野兽会遵守约定？小麦种在他们地上，管辖、分...

say:16:1523204011:1.text: Just by keeping the food, they could assert total power over us!
say:16:1523204011:1.source_cn: 他们想要控制呼临，甚至想要毁灭呼临，都是轻而易举——只...

choice_prompt:17:1523204011.text: Just by keeping the food, they could assert total power over us!
choice_prompt:17:1523204011.source_cn: 他们想要控制呼临，甚至想要毁灭呼临，都是轻而易举——只要不分给呼临粮食就行了！

say:18:1523204012:1.text: Can't believe you have another mage in tow. Bakis, haven't you seen their true colors?
say:18:1523204012:1.source_cn: 又一个魔法师？比博啊比博，你还没看清这些魔法师的真面目吗？
say:18:1523204012:1.male: Can't believe you have another mage in tow. Bakis, haven't you seen their true colors?
say:18:1523204012:1.female: Can't believe you have another mage in tow. Bakis, haven't you seen their true colors?

say:19:1523204013:1.text: He's an honored guest of the Regulus and has done a lot for Halia's peace!
say:19:1523204013:1.male: He's an honored guest of the Regulus and has done a lot for Halia's peace!
say:19:1523204013:1.female: She's an honored guest of the Regulus and has done a lot for Halia's peace!

say:21:1523204015:1.text: Outsiders have no right to meddle with our affairs! Escort him out now!
say:21:1523204015:1.source_cn: 呼临城的内政不容外人插手！卫兵，把<male>他</m...
say:21:1523204015:1.male: Outsiders have no right to meddle with our affairs! Escort him out now!
say:21:1523204015:1.female: Outsiders have no right to meddle with our affairs! Escort her out now!

choice:17:1:2.text: It was your side that started the war, after all.
choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 毕竟是呼临先发动的战争
choice:17:1:2.male: It was your side that started the war, after all.
choice:17:1:2.female: It was your side that started the war, after all.

choice:17:2:3.text: The Arcane Council will oversee things.
choice:17:2:3.source_cn: 魔法师协会会从旁监督
choice:17:2:3.male: The Arcane Council will oversee things.
choice:17:2:3.female: The Arcane Council will oversee things.
